name: Golden Designs Gracia Elite 1-2 Person Ultra Low EMF FAR Indoor Infrared Sauna | DYN-6119-01 Elite
description: Dynamic Gracia 1-2-person Low EMF (Between 5-10MG) FAR Infrared Sauna (Canadian Hemlock) The New 2026 Model Dynamic Gracia Elite sauna is a compact and advanced wellness sanctuary designed for 1-2 people, bringing the therapeutic power of FAR infrared heat into any home. This elite model is meticulously crafted from natural, reforested Canadian Hemlock wood, offering a durable, non-toxic, and aesthetically pleasing cabin. The core of its innovation lies in its seven Dynamic Ultra Low EMF Carbon heating panels, which deliver a deep, penetrating heat while maintaining an exceptionally low electromagnetic field level, typically between 3-5 MG. This ensures a safe, effective, and pure heat therapy experience for detoxification, stress reduction, and muscle recovery. The "Gracia" Elite is engineered for a seamless and highly personalized user experience. Its modern design is highlighted by a clear tempered glass door, while the interior is a hub of wellness technology. The built-in Chromotherapy Color Lighting System, complete with a red light therapy feature, allows you to customize your session for mood enhancement and skin rejuvenation. All of these features, along with Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connectivity for your favorite audio, are easily managed from the intuitive Interior LED Control Panel, making every sauna session a complete retreat for the senses. Ultra Low EMF - EMF Between 3 to 5MG- 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels Features Delivery: This item will be delivered curbside only on a pallet by a freight carrier. Capacity: 1-2 person Heating Elements: 7 Dynamic Low EMF (EMF between 5-10MG - 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels) FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels 2 on the rear wall 2 on each side wall, and 1 under the bench Wood Type: Natural Reforested Canadian Hemlock wood construction Glass: Clear Tempered glass door with a side Window Interior Lighting: Interior Chromotherapy Color Lighting System + Red Light Feature Control Panels: Interior LED control panels Sound System: Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connection with built-in speakers Temperature Range: 118F-132F is the ideal temperature range. The sauna can heat up to 140°F Exterior dimensions (WDH): 39″ x 36″ x 75″ Interior dimensions (WDH): 35″ x 32″ x 68″ Natural hemlock wood construction Electrical service: 120 V/15 AMP Non-GFCI plug & play (Recommend Dedicated Outlet) Location: Indoor Use Only Clasp together the assembly Roof vent Specifications Ideal Temperature Range 118°F - 132°F / sauna can heat up to 140°F Dimensions 36" L X 39" W X 75" H Sauna Weight 255 lbs. Shipping Weight 315 lbs. Ships in 1 or 2 boxes Assembly & Maintenance Assembly Easy assembly by two people. For full details, please refer to the Product Manual Maintenance Since infrared saunas do not require hot rocks, water, or steam to operate, they require very little maintenance. You can simply wipe it down with water - use a damp, soft, and clean cloth. Do not use any chemical-based cleaning agents as they can be absorbed into the wood and released into your sauna during use.
